sources.title: Blum TANDEM plus BLUMOTION 563H/563 installation instructions (Blum)
sources.note: Page 3 and 4 tables for 563H4570B (drawer length, runner length, inside cabinet depth), page 2 drawer box specifications (width minus 42, thickness, clearances, max height), and locking device part numbers

sources.title: TANDEM plus BLUMOTION Premium Concealed Runners for Wood Drawers brochure
sources.note: Static load capacity 100 lb, max drawer thickness 16 mm

sources.title: Blum 563H4570B 18 in TANDEM + BLUMOTION runner (McKillican)
sources.note: Nominal length 457 mm, steel, dynamic load bearing 30 kg

mounting: Concealed full-extension runner screwed to the inside face of the cabinet side (frameless or inset), with a locking device clipped under each end of the drawer front and a rear hook in the drawer back. The drawer box sits on the runners, so nothing shows beside it.
notes: Numbers from Blum's TANDEM plus BLUMOTION 563H sheet: drawer length 457, runner length 471, inside cabinet depth 480 to 522, drawer inside width = opening width minus 42, side thickness 13 to 16, bottom recess 13, bottom clearance 14, minimum top clearance 6, maximum drawer height = opening minus 20, setback 3. Clearance per side of 6 mm is derived from the sheet's width table for 15 mm sides (12 mm deducted from the opening, so 6 each side); it changes with side thickness (5 mm at 16, 8 mm at 13). Static load 100 lb (about 45 kg) is from Blum's brochure; dynamic load 30 kg is from the McKillican listing, so load_kg uses the lower figure. The model is a simplified box in the bottom-clearance zone, not the real runner profile. For an inset slab front the runner setback must be taken from Blum's inset table on page 5 of the sheet, which I did not use to size anything here. Ordered as a pair per drawer, with a left and right locking device sold separately (T51.1901L and T51.1901R, or T51.1801L and R).
